body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An attack targets the creature from a source you detect, before rolling. Response (unopposed): Grant +1 to its targeted Defense against that attack.

surges.html: Reveal the attacker's occupied space to the protected target.
The target becomes Rallied until the start of your next turn if the attack misses.
